    Modifier and Type
    Class
    Description
    class 
    CharacterConstructor
    Constructor's effect: upon purchase, increases the player's permanent discount on buildings by a value equal to the card's level.
    class 
    CharacterHunter
    Hunter's effect: upon purchase, provides food equal to the number of hunters already owned by the player (including the one just picked).
    class 
    CharacterPassive
    "Passive" effect shared by Artist, Inventor, and Gatherer: they produce nothing upon purchase, they only count as statistics for endgame scoring and events.
    class 
    CharacterShaman
    Shaman's effect: upon purchase, provides magic points equal to the card's level.

    Modifier and Type
    Class
    Description
    class 
    EventArtist
    Cave Paintings event effect: those who reach the artists threshold gain proportional aura, those who do not reach it suffer a penalty.
    class 
    EventFarmer
    Sustenance event effect: each player must "feed" their tribe by paying 1 food per card, discounted by gatherers (and buildings); if the food is not enough, they pay the difference in aura.
    class 
    EventHunter
    Hunting event effect: rewards each player based on the number of hunters in their tribe, taking into account any temporary modifiers set by buildings.
    class 
    EventShaman
    Shamanic Ritual event effect: rewards in aura the one with the most magic points and penalizes the one with the least, respecting the shields/doublings set by buildings.
